title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.


Your challenge

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
  • Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
  • Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
  • Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
  • Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
  • Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
  • Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing too

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

As the Tech Lead for the backend, frontend, mobile and fullstack software engineers, you will own and shape the architecture of the underlying services as well as their technical roadmap for the services that together create Treeline, our application that helps predict and prevent wildfires, storm events and generally power and train outages due to vegetation, weather and climate.

Technically, that means rendering and querying large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in both browser, mobile and backend, handling complex and custom business logic, writing the services that make that fast, and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.

We are a team of five engineers today, actively growing, embedded in a cross-functional group of product managers, UX/UI designers, data, DevOps, ML, and geospatial engineering experts. You will not be the only person responsible for any system you touch and we’re a friendly bunch.


Your challenge

  • Lead, support and coordinate the team that builds Treeline while still being around 60% hands-on
  • Architect, build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Design and build well-designed, performant API endpoints and backend services used by partners and customers
  • Coordinate tightly with other functions in cross-functional temporary squads
  • Shape and influence how your team works and how we work together in a greater context

Stack:
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: NestJS, TypeORM
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads, PostGIS and OGC)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: AWS, GitLab

title: Operations Generalist
description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

We're looking for an exceptional junior to join our Brokerage Operations team, either a recent graduate or someone with 1-2 years' full-time work experience. You'll support the day-to-day running of our Trade & Settlements function, covering everything from transaction reporting and fails management to best execution analysis. Over time you'll build genuine expertise across the full trade lifecycle, working alongside Trading, Settlements, Transfers, Payments, Corporate Actions and Tax.

You'll also get hands-on exposure to process improvement and automation, including advanced Google Sheets, Apps Script, Regular Expressions, SQL, Zapier, and AI tools like Claude, working closely with technical specialists and engineering.
